SELECT eis.id AS systemId, eis.system_id AS systemUuid, eis.name, eis.code, eis.version, eis.desc AS description, eis.biz_create_time AS bizCreateTime, eis.biz_update_time AS bizUpdateTime, eis.last_use_time AS lastUseTime, eis.use_count AS useCount, eis.creator, eis.updater, eis.create_time AS createTime, eis.update_time AS updateTime,
sot.name AS objectTypeName, ss.name AS statusName
FROM eval_index_system eis
LEFT JOIN sys_object_type sot ON eis.object_type_id = sot.type_id LEFT JOIN sys_status ss ON eis.status_id = ss.status_id
WHERE eis.id = #{id} AND eis.deleted = 0
SELECT eic.id AS categoryId, eic.category_id AS categoryUuid, eic.name, eic.sort_no, eic.weight FROM eval_index_category eic WHERE eic.system_id = #{systemUuid} AND eic.deleted = 0

SELECT eii.id AS itemId, eii.item_id AS itemUuid, eic.id AS categoryId, eii.name, eii.threshold, eii.weight, eii.sort_no AS sortNo, eii.comment_rule_id AS commentRuleId, eii.comment_category_id AS commentCategoryId, erc.name AS commentCategoryName, ecr.rule_name AS ruleName,
sit.name AS indexTypeName, scw.name AS calcWayName
FROM eval_index_item eii
INNER JOIN eval_index_category eic ON eii.category_id = eic.category_id AND eic.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN eval_comment_rule ecr ON eii.comment_rule_id = ecr.id AND ecr.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN eval_rule_category erc ON eii.comment_category_id = erc.id AND erc.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN sys_index_type sit ON eii.index_type_id = sit.type_id
LEFT JOIN sys_calc_way scw ON eii.calc_way_id = scw.way_id
WHERE eic.id IN
#{categoryId}
AND eii.deleted = 0 ORDER BY eii.sort_no ASC
SELECT SUM(weight) FROM eval_index_category WHERE system_id = #{systemId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT SUM(weight) FROM eval_index_item WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND deleted = 0
